It's just a whole heap of stuff shoved onto a skewer, but it's still a pretty tasty dish.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Copious Seafood Skewers can be made by [[Cooking]] four different types of [[Seafood]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. When eaten, they heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. Despite being a heap of random [[Item]]s shoved onto a skewer, they are known to be a tasty dish. Because of their specified recipe, very few variations of Copious Seafood Skewers exist. They can only be made by combining a [[Hyrule Bass]], a [[Sanke Carp]], and two different types of seafood that grant the same effect. These variations are as follows: * '''Hearty Copious Seafood Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Copious Seafood Skewers}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
It's just a whole heap of stuff shoved on to a skewer, but it's still a pretty tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using any combination of [[Hearty Salmon]]s, [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]]s, or [[Hearty Bass]]. When eaten, it will fully heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Energizing Copious Seafood Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Copious Seafood Skewers}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
It's just a whole heap of stuff shoved on to a skewer, but it's still a pretty tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Staminoka Bass]]es and [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s. If they're eaten, they refill a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Mighty Copious Seafood Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Copious Seafood Skewers}}
Grants a mid-level attack-power boost.
It's just a whole heap of stuff shoved on to a skewer, but it's still a pretty tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using any combination of [[Mighty Carp]], [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]], or [[Razorclaw Crab]]s. Eating one will grant Link a temporary boost to his attack power. * '''Tough Copious Seafood Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Copious Seafood Skewers}}
Grants a mid-level defense boost.
It's just a whole heap of stuff shoved on to a skewer, but it's still a pretty tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using any combination of [[Armored Carp]], [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]], or [[Ironshell Crab]]s. When they're eaten, Link's defense will be temporarily boosted. * '''Sneaky Copious Seafood Skewers''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Copious Seafood Skewers}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
It's just a whole heap of stuff shoved on to a skewer, but it's still a pretty tasty dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Stealthfin Trout]]s and [[Sneaky River Snail]]s. Eating them increases Link's [[Stealth]] for a short period of time. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Much like their {{BotW}} counterparts, Copious Seafood Skewers can be made by [[Cooking]] four different types of [[Seafood]] together. When eaten, they restore some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. They have also retained their reputation as delicious [[Meal]]s. Variations of Copious Seafood Skewers can be made using any combination of [[Hyrule Bass]]es, [[Sanke Carp]]s, or [[Ancient Arowana]]s, and any other type of Seafood. The addition of Ancient Arrowanas as a neutral ingredient allows for new variations that were not available in {{BotW|-}}.
